chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Muhammad ibn Hamzah al-Alawi, who said: 'Ubayyidullah ibn Ali informed me, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him), who said:

I frequently heard my father saying: 'He is not from our Shia, the one whose devoutness is not talked about by the women in their coverings; and he is not from our friends, the one who is in a town wherein are ten thousand men, among them is a creature of Allah who is more devout than him'.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of a true Shia according to the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) establishes 'war'' (asceticism/piety) as the definitive marker of authentic Shia identity, emphasizing that true devotion is not merely internal but manifests in a public reputation so profound that even the women of the household testify to it. It further posits a comparative standard, asserting that within any large community, the true friend of Allah will invariably be the most pious, thereby linking spiritual excellence with social recognition in Shia theological tradition.
